integration.default_state: all breakers and valves closed; no faults; fans off; doors closed
integration.static_collision: architecture boxes plus stair ramp proxies; exclude equipment envelopes, service lines, glass and door aperture cutters
integration.doors: separate dynamic collider, 900/1000 mm openings; restore door state by opening ID
integration.streaming: group B1/G0/L1/roof/site/services; room occlusion, exterior roof hide on indoor camera
integration.performance: budgets for reference asset: <=2000 nodes, <=50000 triangles; runtime FPS requires host testing

dependencies.pump: PUMP circuit + check valve + clear discharge
dependencies.hot_water: SHUTOFF + COLD_MANIFOLD + HEATER_E + fuel + heater healthy

integration.repair: isolation verification precedes repair; restored power alone does not clear fault
integration.time_step: 1 simulated second; limit dt to 60 s; tank and pump capacities bound accumulation
integration.live_engine_status: reference tests only; integrate according to source/reference_sim.py and Game_Integration.md

scope_exclusions: No structural certification, real installation ratings, product selection, survey or regulatory approval.
Live Johansson World repository runtime acceptance is not performed; this delivery contains integration specifications and tested reference simulation.

service_co_routing: Same-family branches may share trunk/conduit centre-lines; vent and soil are one continuous stack. Distinct service families have zero physical tube-envelope clashes. Ports are offset inside 250 mm logical equipment envelopes.

assemblies.exterior: 200 mm nominal reinforced concrete; game wall finish weathered cream; exterior waterproof membrane below grade
assemblies.partitions: 120 mm nominal concrete/masonry visual walls; isolated sliding apertures
assemblies.floors: 180 mm nominal slab; top equals FFL; additional floor finish represented in material, not elevation offset
assemblies.foundation: 400 mm nominal perimeter footing, 300 mm deep; geometric game representation only
assemblies.roof: hipped tile shell; underside 5680; eaves5800/ridge8000; 400 overhang; lower deck5420-5600
assemblies.wet_zones: tiled finish, floor drain/trap state, watertight sleeve and equipment isolation
assemblies.shutters: optional weather-state art variant, no structural claim
assemblies.weathering: salt staining at fittings, roof tile mottling, worn timber sliding doors
assemblies.roof_sleeves: 140 x140 shaft apertures around100 mm vent/flue; 20 radial clearance; four-sided weather collars provided as cosmetic roof solids
